insights.headline: Patchwork: 1.5% → 18.9% sign-ups. "The Speed Demon" is the champion after 3 generations (108/570 across its rounds).

The Original Gen 1 positioning consistently underperformed with just 3/200 conversions, while Drive-by visitors converted poorly across all variants, topping out at 2/34.
